cityTerrain.limitation: Native 5 m ground DTM is not a road, bridge, stair or building-foundation survey. Missing coastal samples are explicitly estimated or retained flat.

cityWorld.representation: OSM footprint extrusions; foundation and facade details are visual estimates

realFacades.calibration: inferred manual photo alignment, not surveyed geometry or photogrammetry

source.name: Grand Hotel Santa Lucia · fronte su Via Partenope
source.identitySource: https://www.santalucia.it/location-e-contatti/ — Via Partenope 46; SANTA LUCIA nameplate in the original 2010 CC0 photograph.
source.observedLayout: Ten architectural bays, with twin openings in each outer wing: twelve glazed openings per upper register. Five upper glazed registers include the shorter attic; two rusticated base registers remain below. Upper balcony guards are dark iron; the long lower terrace guard is pale stone. These observed registers are not a replacement for the source OSM six-level tag. Dimensions and depth are inferred, not a measured architectural survey.

source.modelPolicy: Four arched openings are confirmed in the 2011 photograph: two outer glazed openings and two central wooden door openings. The flat canopy interpretation is constrained to the unchanged source proxy footprint; no unsupported stone guard is added on its roof. The source 10 m proxy height is only an untagged OSM fallback. Inferred slab height and depth are not measured. Source and collision geometry remain unchanged.

santaLucia.calibration: original photo and source walls; inferred manual alignment and profile depths, not photogrammetry

visualDetail.photographicMaps: CC0 surfaces and foliage; two CC0 and one FAL-1.3 selected real Naples hotel fronts; inferred depth, not photogrammetry
